title: Sidra Jewellery & Fashion — Admin Dashboard
tagline: The back office that runs the jewellery shop
description: The admin dashboard behind the Sidra Jewellery & Fashion demo: "Needs your attention today" with orders waiting for a confirmation call, the order pipeline from pending to delivered with invoice PDFs, fake-order protection (🟢 Trusted / 🟡 New / 🔴 Verify), abandoned checkouts, products by material and plating with SKUs, collections and sets with a photo picker, gift-wrap orders flagged for packing, coupons, banners, reviews, delivery zones, staff roles, reports and the activity log — in Bangla and English. It is the real admin code running in the browser, sharing its data with the shop demo.
highlights: Opens straight into the dashboard — no sign-in needed
COD orders can't be confirmed until the customer's call is logged — try it on a pending order
Invoice PDF, call and WhatsApp buttons on every order
Search by order no, invoice no, phone or SKU; CSV export on every list
42 fictional orders over nine weeks, so the charts and reports have something to show

credentials.label: Admin dashboard sign-in
credentials.note: Opens already signed in. After Sign out, sign back in with these (they are filled in for you). Staff can also sign in by phone: 01899999999 — the SMS code shows on screen. Everything is fictional demo data kept in your browser; add ?demo-reset to the address to start fresh.
